'''Gas grenades''' were hand [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] that upon impact, deployed an airborne chemical agent that incapacitated targets. It also had the secondary effect of filling the blast area with a temporary smokescreen. Some gas grenades were more lethal, such as the [[FEX-M3 nerve gas grenade]] and [[Poison gas grenade/Legends|poison gas grenade]]. [[Droid/Legends|Droids]] were immune to the grenades' effects as they did not breathe. Some beings, such as the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]], were likewise immune due to the fact that they wore [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]]. Some [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were able to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Detoxify Poison|rid themselves]] of the poison.

In addition to [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]] and [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]], all [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|Zero-gravity stormtrooper]] armor incorporated shoulder-mounted [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]] that were loaded with gas grenades.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide" />
